name: default
about: TIRNHALLOW, the shipped world (docs/WORLD_tirnhallow.md): built by scripts/design_world.mjs from docs/WORLD_brief.md, then the owner's to edit on the tuner's Environment > World map page. Re-running the script overwrites the planes and the vector layers.

terrain.about: The terrain, per MAP: the seeded NOISE on the authored height plane (map v2). Lengths in voxels at refVoxelsPerMetre; log2 cells are shifts; fbmAtten / sedFraction / sedSlope / rockSlope are Q8 counts. The ground is planes.height (absolute voxels) + range/hill/detail/grain (the seeded octave ladder; the biome curve shapes the range rung); homeArea is the calm noise around the spawn site (radius, fade). The sediment wedge fills where the noise sits below the AUTHORED ground + sedAbove (relative, map v2 A1). treeline is the map's ground Y of the treeline: a column's own is sea + (treeline - sea) x its biome's treelineScale, +- treelineJitter. rockSlope: columns at least this steep skin as rock (0 = off). baseHeight is the height used only when no plane is loaded. Per-biome relief is each biome file's `terrain` block.

sites.about: Where the game starts, and the centre of the calm home area (terrain.homeArea). Must be on land and off any lake: the spawn-site gate checks all of that. In the wood south of Harrowby, so a new game wakes among trees with the village ahead (north); it was (580, 3515), on the green's edge, until 2026-09-29.

Harrowby's ground (docs/EDITOR_GUIDE.md section 14): inside this box the biome's own rolling relief is kept at a fraction of its swells (hills) and 3 m bumps (bumps), with no sub-metre grain and the tracks between the doors flatter still (paths), easing back to the untouched forest floor across the feather. No clearing: the forest stands among the houses, and every tree whose crown would come within 1 m of a building is left out (the per-tree building rule); the houses level their own floors and doorsteps and ease into this ground over their ramps (refs/harrowby.json padMargin / padApron).
An AUTHORED lake (P-F): same place on every seed, the spawn_lake preset's geometry. Placed on the map, not relative to the spawn; the spawn-site gate checks the spawn stays off it.
Cinder's Maw: a lava pool on the caldera floor (preset lava_pool).
A second, smaller spring among the dunes east of the Oasis of Sunscour (preset oasis).

locales.name: Harrowby
locales.about: The hamlet north of the spawn (docs/EDITOR_GUIDE.md section 14). Its refs (refs/harrowby.json) are stored with y RELATIVE to anchor.y; at load the engine adds the bare ground at anchor.at for the seed in force, so the whole village rides the ground if the world under it is reshaped. Its own ground cells are locales/harrowby/ground.svedit.

rivers.name: Hollowcrown Beck
rivers.about: The Silverrun's head: off Hollowcrown's south cirques, down a staircase of falls into Mirrormere.

rivers.name: The Silverrun
rivers.about: Out of Mirrormere through the Merewall notch, down the Mere Stair, south through Hearthvale past Harrowby to its delta in Gull Bay.

rivers.name: The Silverrun
rivers.about: Out of the Twinmere, south through Hearthvale to its delta in Gull Bay.

rivers.name: The Amberbrook
rivers.about: Out of Amberwood, round the west and south of Harrowby, into the Twinmere, the pool where it meets the Silverrun below the village.

rivers.name: The Eldwater
rivers.about: From the Eldwell tarn on Heatherhigh, off the moor's edge and west down the Eldwood to its swampy firth.

rivers.name: The Redrun
rivers.about: Off the Greyspine's east end, through a gorge across the Shardspire tableland, then down its slot canyon through Redreach to the Redmouth.

rivers.name: The Glimmer
rivers.about: The slow, looping fen river of Glimmerfen, out to the Teeth Sound.

rivers.name: The Chalkbourne
rivers.about: A downland stream that ends over the white cliffs: a waterfall straight into the sea.

rivers.name: The Goldwater
rivers.about: Off the Goldsea plain, down its own shallow vale into the east side of Gull Bay.
